questions.q: What kind of mirror did the evil spirit make?
o: One that distorted everything: the good and beautiful vanished, the ugly became uglier
questions.e: Everything good and beautiful faded in it, and everything ugly looked even uglier.

questions.q: What happened to the mirror when the imps carried it up toward heaven?
o: It shook, fell from their hands and shattered into countless pieces
questions.e: It smashed on the ground into millions of shards.

questions.q: How did Kay and Gerda live?
o: Like siblings, in neighbouring attics with a shared little garden on the gutter
In one house, as husband and wife
questions.e: They weren't brother and sister, but loved each other like real siblings.

questions.q: What happened to Kay when the clock struck five?
o: Splinters of the mirror got into his eye and his heart
questions.e: A splinter of glass got into his eye and into his heart.

o: He became mean and mocking: he broke the roses and teased Gerda and his grandmother
questions.e: He tore off the roses and teased Gerda and his grandmother.

questions.q: How did Kay end up with the Snow Queen?
o: He tied his sled to her white sleigh and she carried him out of the city
The queen came to his house
He walked into the mountains himself
questions.e: He tied his sled to the Snow Queen's white sleigh.

questions.q: What did Gerda do when Kay disappeared?
o: Put on her red shoes and went to the river to ask about Kay
questions.e: “I'll put on my red shoes and go to the river; I'll ask it about him.”
